param p1 = 20 in [7, 60]
param p2 = 100 in [33, 300]
param p3 = 0.02 in [0.005, 0.08]

let f = sma(close, p1)
let s = sma(close, p2)
enter_long when crossover(f, s)
exit_long when crossunder(f, s)
set stop_loss = p3

param p1 = 8 in [3, 24]
param p2 = 5 in [2, 15]
param p3 = 30 in [10, 90]
param p4 = 30 in [10, 90]

enter_long when (crossover(low, sma(close, p1)) or roc(close, p2) < (-0.0167)) and roc(close, p3) > (-0.0171)
exit_long when roc(close, p4) < (-0.0184) or crossunder(ema(close, 80), sma(close, 13))
set stop_loss = 0.0751

param p1 = 120 in [40, 360]
param p2 = 14 in [5, 42]
param p3 = 2 in [2, 3]
param p4 = 120 in [40, 360]

let hi_ch = highest(high, p1)
let vol = atr(p2)
enter_long when close > delay(hi_ch, p3)
exit_long when crossunder(close, sma(close, p4))
set trail_stop = 3 * vol / close

param p1 = 14 in [5, 42]
param p2 = 0.03 in [0.0075, 0.12]
param p3 = 0.5 in [0.1875, 0.5]

let r = rsi(close, p1)
enter_long when crossover(r, 30)
exit_long when crossover(r, 70)
set stop_loss = p2
set size = p3

param p1 = 19 in [6, 57]
param p2 = 30 in [10, 90]
param p3 = 80 in [27, 240]
param p4 = 30 in [10, 90]

enter_long when crossunder(delay(close, p1), highest(high, p2))
exit_long when rsi(close, p3) < 72 and sma(close, p4) > sma(close, 120) and crossunder(delay(close, 21), ema(close, 30))

param p1 = 8 in [3, 24]
param p2 = 20 in [7, 60]
param p3 = 20 in [7, 60]
param p4 = 30 in [10, 90]

enter_long when close - sma(close, p1) < 2.6 * atr(p2)
exit_long when rsi(close, p3) > 30 and crossover(ema(close, p4), highest(high, 50)) or close - sma(close, 80) > 2.65 * atr(300)
set stop_loss = 0.0383
set take_profit = 0.0634
